scams.name: Rio Galeão Airport (GIG) & Santos Dumont (SDU) Taxi Mafia & Late-Night Uber Confusion
scams.avoidance: Book Uber/99/Cabify on airport Wi-Fi: GIG-Zona Sul R$ 90–R$ 160 Meet driver at 'Aplicativos' signposted pickup zone; SDU R$ 25–R$ 60 OR Premium / Frescão airport bus R$ 27 per person (90 min) NEVER hand credit card to any taxi driver Late-night: Uber Comfort/Black R$ 30–R$ 50 surcharge for vetted drivers
scams.location: Galeão–Antônio Carlos Jobim International Airport (GIG, Terminals 1 & 2), Santos Dumont Airport (SDU) downtown, 'Special Coop' / 'Transcoopass' kiosks, late-night arrivals corridor

scams.name: Rio Caipirinha Bar 'R$ 10,000 Bill' Honeypot Scam in Lapa & Copacabana
scams.avoidance: NEVER let a stranger walk you to a 'best bar' — pick venue yourself Reputable Lapa: Rio Scenarium, Carioca da Gema, Bar do Mineiro Photograph menu BEFORE ordering; verify caipirinha R$ 18–R$ 45 Refuse hostess; pay with credit card ONLY and dispute via bank Polícia Turística DEAT +55 21 2334 6802 (24/7 English)
scams.location: Lapa nightlife district (Avenida Mem de Sá, Rua do Lavradio), Copacabana boardwalk bars, Ipanema late-night street-bars, 'friendly local' guided pub crawls

scams.name: Copacabana / Ipanema Beach Pickpocket & 'Arrastão' Sweep Theft Ring
scams.avoidance: Bring NOTHING to the beach you can't afford to lose Use quiosque chair-and-umbrella R$ 30–R$ 50; staff watches belongings NEVER leave items on towel while swimming Carnaval / NYE: arrastão risk 5–10×; valuables in hotel safe DEAT Tourist Police +55 21 2334 6802; BO within 24 hours
scams.location: Copacabana beach (Posto 2–6 zones), Ipanema beach (Posto 8–10 zones), Leblon beach, beach kiosks (quiosques), Avenida Atlântica boardwalk evenings

scams.name: Christ Redeemer & Sugarloaf 'Skip-the-Line VIP' Tour Operator Fraud
scams.avoidance: Book Christ Redeemer ONLINE direct: paineirascorcovado.com.br R$ 105–R$ 116 Book Sugarloaf direct: bondinho.com.br R$ 140 REFUSE every 'skip-the-line' / 'VIP' / 'fast-track' upsell Optimal: Christ at 8 AM opening; Sugarloaf at sunset Reputable operators: Tour Brazilis, Free Walker Tours, Carioca Tropical, Rio By Cab
scams.location: Cosme Velho train station (Trem do Corcovado), Paineiras Shuttle Vans, Urca Sugarloaf cable-car base, Copacabana / Ipanema hotel-concierge tour desks

scams.name: Rio Favela Tour Unethical Operator & Fake-Charity 'Slum Safari' Scam
scams.avoidance: Strongly consider NOT visiting — community ethics weak case for tourism If visiting, ONLY community-led: Favela Inc, Tour Pelos Olhos da Rocinha, Spirit Travel AVOID Olafemi Tours per 2025 community warning Check Polícia Militar updates BEFORE for active operations NEVER photograph residents (especially children) without consent
scams.location: Rocinha favela tours, Vidigal favela tours, Santa Marta favela tours, Cosme Velho tour-pickup vans, Lapa hostel tour-desk bookings

scams.name: Rio Carnaval & Réveillon Booking.com / Airbnb Cancel-and-Relist Fraud
scams.avoidance: Book Carnaval / Réveillon 6–9 months ahead via hotel chains, NOT Airbnb Reputable: Hilton, Marriott, Belmond Copacabana Palace, Fasano, Pestana NEVER PIX/WhatsApp-bank-transfer to private 'apartment' sellers Sambódromo tickets ONLY from official Liesa: liesa.globo.com DEAT +55 21 2334 6802; chargeback denuncia within 48 hours
scams.location: Booking.com Rio Carnaval listings (Feb–Mar window), Réveillon (NYE) Copacabana hotel inventory, WhatsApp 'private apartment' Carnaval rentals, Airbnb Sambódromo-area listings
